{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify rows where age is -1
age_minus_1 = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]

# Check if these rows are in the 'converted' group
converted_in_negative_age = age_minus_1['converted'].value_counts()

# Now, compute the mean age of converted customers, but exclude rows with age = -1
# First, filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Now, exclude any converted customer with age = -1
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age_valid = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_age_valid"}
